message: Fixed dispatch (added case scribe to main switch + updated usage string), updated cmdLog test expectation to include new kind/source fields, added full scribe test suite (write mode, auto-register, no-goal-record, bad-type rejection, missing-text rejection, --recent empty/filter/N=8/N=3/--provider, backward-compat, concurrency guard). All 27 tests pass.

Created packages/monitor/skills/cockpit-scribe/SKILL.md: full fork procedure with CLI-path resolution (no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT), git diff/log lens step, dedup via cockpit scribe --recent, all four kind values with when-to-use table, exact CLI surface from log-schema, consolidation bias, and log_language handling.

Added kind class (is-kind-* with KINDS whitelist) and scribe source badge to decisionCard() in decision-log.js; updated empty-state CTA to mention /thoughtful; added is-kind-rationale/learning/caveat left-border accents, per-kind ::before label overrides (RATIONALE/LEARNING/CAVEAT), and .decision-card__source-badge pill rule to style.css — all using existing Night Flight tokens; decision kind and legacy records (no kind/source) unchanged.

Created packages/monitor/skills/thoughtful/SKILL.md: mode-injection skill that teaches agents WHEN to log (non-obvious decisions, tricky problems, caveats, learnings; skip trivial turns) and HOW to spawn a background /cockpit-scribe fork (Claude: Agent tool omitting subagent_type for context-warm inheritance; Codex: fork_context:true no agent_type), with no-cockpit-start auto-register note, best-effort caveat, and fire-and-forget framing. All acceptance criteria met.

Bumped all three monitor version fields from 3.6.5 to 3.7.0 (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json monitor entry, packages/monitor/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, packages/monitor/.codex-plugin/plugin.json) and added a [3.7.0] CHANGELOG.md entry with an Added section covering /thoughtful mode, the cockpit scribe CLI subcommand, and dashboard entry kinds/source badges. Verified all three fields agree via grep.

All 5 lenses fired (codex, reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude); codex DID run (not unreachable) and raised 1 P2: Codex scribe forks omit --provider so auto-resolve defaults to claude, misfiling/failing Codex auto-log. Total ~16 findings. Fixes applied: (1) codex P2 — cockpit-scribe SKILL now sets PROVIDER_FLAG and appends it to every scribe call; thoughtful SKILL Codex spawn prompt now states the surface + mandates --provider codex. (2) extracted shared readDecisionRecords() helper, collapsing 3 duplicated read-split-filter-parse JSONL blocks (reuse/simplification/altitude consensus). (3) VALID_KINDS now single-source  with DecisionKind derived from it; validate raw string, narrow after guard (drops misleading cast). (4) dropped redundant refreshHeartbeat after upsertSession in cmdScribe (efficiency — double registry write). (5) hoisted dashboard KINDS to module level + cross-ref sync comments in ts/js. Rejected: weakening the id-anywhere persistence guard to a tail-only read (would lose the concurrency-safety scribe deliberately added) and building a shared kind module across Bun/SPA (over-engineering, no-build-step). Verification: bun test cockpit = 220 pass / 0 fail; e2e steps 1-4 all green (auto-register tracked:true, kind:learning+source:scribe, --recent dedup lists only scribe entries & ignores legacy/manual, invalid --type rejected, manual log stamps source:agent/kind:decision, legacy no-kind record unaffected, codex provider honored in registry); 3 version fields aligned at 3.7.0 + matching CHANGELOG; empty-state CTA mentions /thoughtful. PLAN goal met.
